payload.summary: Warlock is hybrid summoner + magic caster. Permanent Soulgorger demon companion (passive, lv1 — Warp Strike teleport at lv15, health sacrifice heals). Temporary summons via Demonic Portal (Bloodlord/Warriors/Rasplet Hulk), Demonic Pact (Twisted Shaman), Lunatic Rush (Fallen Lunatic). Magic: Hellfire Bolt (ultimate rain of meteors), Infernal Eruption, Devouring Darkness, Tyrant's Grasp, Brimstone Gateway. Health-cost mechanics on select skills (Devouring Darkness, Demonic Pact, Spiteful Sacrifice via The Dark Trade). No named resource — cooldown only.
